description: Plans for a trip to one or more countries: estimates the data needed from the days and how the user uses their phone, then suggests the best-value plans that cover every country for the whole trip.

countries.description: Every country the user will visit

items.description: ISO code like "SK" or a country name like "Slovakia"

currency.description: Show and sort prices in this currency (EUR or USDT)

dataGB.description: Data the user wants, if they know it; overrides usage

days.description: Length of the trip in days

newEsim.description: Default true. false: the user already has a GLOBALCELL eSIM

usage.description: light: maps, messaging, email, a little browsing; normal: plus social media, photos and some music; heavy: plus video, video calls or sharing data with a laptop. Default normal

name: recommend_plans
title: Recommend plans for a trip
